title: Ice barrier.
officialText:
An ice barrier that consists of at least two layers of underlayment cemented together or of a self-adhering
polymer-modified bitumen sheet, shall extend from the lowest edges of all roof surfaces to a point at least 24 inches (610 mm)
inside the exterior wall line of the building.
Exception: Detached accessory structures that contain no conditioned floor area.
